name: Causeway: Lower Terrace
summary: A lower-elevation terrace of the Causeway, once a Dragorn ceremonial platform now fortified by Muramite patrols.
description: The Lower Terrace is the first elevation above Nobles’ Causeway. Once used for Dragorn noble gatherings, it now serves as a Muramite staging platform. Broken ceremonial pillars line the terrace, Discord fissures crack the stone, and Dragorn resistance fighters use the ruins for ambushes. Muramite patrols maintain control, but instability from nearby fissures makes the area unpredictable and dangerous.
